info.syllabusName: Information System Programming Project_Dự án lập trình hệ thống thông tin
info.description:
This course focuses on designing, developing, and integrating the basic Web-based system/application using Java Web or .NET technologies (with the system requirements, technical framework & DBMS as assigned/agreed by the teacher)

Students are required to build the system in teams, 4-5 members/team as appointed by the teacher.

After the course, students will be able to achieve web programing proficiency with the following skills by practicing with other members in the assigned team

- Proficiency in common web techniques and basic Java or .NET Web development skills

- Proficiency in front end skills (HTML, CSS, JS) required for the industry

- Analyze & design the solution following the object oriented models

- Co-ordinate with the others to complete the project works
info.studentTasks:
"- Build the team & select/receive the software topic to develop with arrangement/guide from the teacher

- Select the team leader and setup/configure project development and management environments (source codes, tasks, issues, milestones) on the GitLab (or GitHub) & project documents management on the OneDrive (or Google Drive)

- Get the detailed assignment from the teacher, plan the project tasks, and execute the project accordingly

- Students must attend at least 80% of contact slots in order to be accepted to the final presentation.

- Student is responsible to do all exercises given by the teacher in class or at home and submit on time

- Constantly follow the teacher's guides/references for up-to-date course information regarding assignment submission and feedback on assignments and project work.

- Using the GitLab (or GitHub) to collaborate in every phase of the project by all the team members"
info.tools:
One Drive or Google Drive for document management

GitLab (https://gitlab.com/) for issue and code version management

DBMS: as assigned/agreed with the teacher

Java tools

• Tomcat server

• Java JDK version 1.6 or higher, NetBeans 13

.NET tools

• Microsoft Internet Information Services server

• Microsoft Visual Studio version 2019 or higher

assessments.gradingGuide:
The exam is organized by exam board. Must have at least 2 teachers for grading Final Project Presentation. Each team have 45 minutes for presentation.

Evaluate the final presentation, based on what the teams introduce, share, and demonstrate their final software product, mainly focus on:

- Software product/implementation: 40%

- Requirement analyzing: 20%

- Software designing: 20%

- Team working: 20%
assessments.note:
1. To be selected to the Final Presentation, each student needs:

* Average on-going grade assessment >=5/10

* No cheating during the project progress

2. To get the maximum LOC Evaluation, each student need to have 720 LOC as the rated LOC

3. Student will be failed if cheating is found during final presentation (resitting is not allowed for this case)
